**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

I reviewed the fee and payment mechanics (Article V and the volume-band tiers, p0050–p0074), the Supplemental Payments and support-fee provisions (p0077–p0089), the term/termination and post-termination articles (p0049, p0132–p0142), and General Provisions (p0145–p0159), and searched for "liquidated damages," "penalty," "minimum," and "shall pay."

Key points:
- **No Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties.** All Licensee payments are usage-based per-trade fees plus a fixed $2,500/month support charge; there is no minimum-volume commitment, shortfall charge, late-payment interest or acceleration.
- **No early-termination fee.** On termination for our breach, Licensor only retains the right to receive payments "for all trades performed using the Licensed Technology" (p0049) — accrued fees, not a stipulated sum. Article XXI (p0138) requires only return of materials and an officer's certificate.
- **Article XXIII (p0142)** affirmatively bars termination damages against either party, which supports our position.
- The audit cost-shift on a >5% discrepancy (p0064) is reimbursement of actual audit cost, not a penalty, so it does not trigger this rule.

One adjacent observation flagged for the liability-cap rule rather than this one: Article XIII (p0130) caps only the Licensor's liability (at one half of amounts paid) and leaves our indemnity in Article XII (p0128) uncapped.
